description: This multi-level pie chart, or sunburst chart, displays a hierarchical categorization of tasks or capabilities, consisting of three inner segments and nine outer segments. The inner ring is divided into three main categories with bold white text labels placed directly inside the slices: "Contradiction Resolution" (brown), "Context Tracking" (dark blue), and "Context Retrieving" (dark green). The outer ring contains nine subcategories, each visually aligned with an inner category and colored in corresponding hues. Adjacent to "Contradiction Resolution" are "Prioritization" (light red, value 100), "Personalization" (orange, value 100), and "Privacy Protection" (red, value 111). Adjacent to "Context Tracking" are "Triggering" (light blue, value 100), "Recursive Reasoning" (bright blue, value 110), and "Dynamic Environment" (medium blue, value 100). Adjacent to "Context Retrieving" are "Memorization" (light cyan, value 100), "Dynamic Instruction" (cyan, value 100), and "Multitasking" (teal, value 160). The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the outer labels and their corresponding numerical values are positioned outside the chart and connected to their respective slices by thin blue lines. All segments are separated by distinct white borders around a central white hole. While the slices are not ordered by descending size, their widths visually correspond to the numerical values provided, with "Multitasking" appearing as the largest outer slice.
